_readme: Curated layer on top of ecocrop_subset.csv. Every number here carries a source id from `sources`. Unknown values are null, never guessed. To add a crop: add its EcoCrop row to ecocrop_subset.csv and an entry under `crops` here.

ecocrop.citation: FAO EcoCrop database (ecocrop.apps.fao.org). Rows read from the OpenCLIM mirror EcoCrop_DB.csv, github.com/OpenCLIM/ecocrop. Maize (Zea mays, EcoPort 2175) was cross-checked against the FAO data sheet and matched; the other crops were not individually cross-checked.
ecocrop.limitations: Broad, generalised ranges that cover all varieties and many production systems. Rainfall is labelled 'annual' on the FAO sheet; how it maps to a single crop cycle is an assumption made in the recommendation stage. Cycle length spans all varieties.

herridge2021.citation: Herridge, D.F., Giller, K.E., Jensen, E.S., Peoples, M.B. (2021). Quantifying country-to-global scale nitrogen fixation for grain legumes: I. Reliance on nitrogen fixation of soybean, groundnut and pulses. Plant and Soil 469:1-14. doi:10.1007/s11104-021-05167-6
herridge2021.limitations: Values are mean +/- SD of %Ndfa (share of legume N from the atmosphere) for crop GROUPS, not per-crop. Read from the abstract page; author order should be checked against the published article.

lengwati2020.citation: Lengwati, D.M., Mathews, C., Dakora, F.D. (2020). Rotation Benefits From N2-Fixing Grain Legumes to Cereals. Frontiers in Sustainable Food Systems 4:94. doi:10.3389/fsufs.2020.00094
lengwati2020.limitations: ONE site (Nelspruit, South Africa), one fixation season (2011/12, 288 mm rain) and one following maize season (2012/13, 465 mm), maize with no N fertilizer. Indicative of direction and size of benefit only; not transferable as a prediction for other places.

fews_kenya.citation: FEWS NET Data Explorer Knowledge Base, Kenya country book (describes a 2024 Ministry of Agriculture official's regional seasonal calendar).
fews_kenya.limitations: Calendar is given for seasonal crops with 4-7 month cycles as a group, not per crop. Onset of the long rains has become erratic. Not crop- or variety-specific.

recocrop_doc.citation: Recocrop R package documentation (CRAN) on how EcoCrop parameters are used in suitability modelling.
recocrop_doc.limitations: Documentation does not state whether EcoCrop rainfall is a season total; it says FAO gave annual values that Recocrop converts to monthly.

not_yet_covered: Variety-level data (durations, drought/disease tolerance) for any country: needs national lists such as KALRO/KEPHIS for Kenya.
Crop-specific drought tolerance classes: EcoCrop gives rainfall limits only.
Pest and disease break effects per crop pair: no verified source read yet, so none are encoded.
Crop-specific planting calendars: only a grouped seasonal calendar for Western Kenya is included.
Quantified nutrient uptake/removal: EcoCrop's soil fertility requirement is used as the only nutrient-demand signal.

calendars.name: Western and Nyanza Kenya, medium-altitude (bimodal) zones
calendars.bbox_note: Approximate rectangle chosen by this project to represent the region; not an official boundary.
calendars.applies_to: seasonal crops with roughly 4 to 7 month cycles (cereals, pulses, nuts, oil crops), as a group
caveats: Higher-altitude parts of Bungoma and Kakamega are unimodal: planting Mar-Apr, harvest Nov-Dec. Altitude is not yet used to tell these apart.
Long-rains onset has become erratic; planting can stretch from March to May.
Not crop-specific. Long-cycle crops such as cassava are not covered.
